newsitem.title: USA: Continental execs defend stock sales.
newsitem.headline: Continental execs defend stock sales.

text.p: Continental Airlines Inc's top executives in a memo to airline employees on Wednesday said they exercised stock options for tax and investment purposes, and that they would not have sold shares if a merger was imminent.
According to news reports, Continental and Delta are in preliminary merger talks that would create the world's largest airline.

"We would obviously not have exercised stock options if we thought a merger was around the corner which would create a windfall for all stockholders," Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Gordon Bethune and President and Chief Operating Officer Greg Brenneman said in the memo, a copy of which was obtained by Reuters.
In the memo the executives said the airline is constantly assessing options in the event of an industry consolidation.
